title: Design System: e-Lesson Platform Marketing Homepage

display.purpose: Hero h1, section h2 headlines, wordmark only. Never UI chrome or body copy.

body.purpose: All paragraph copy, nav, buttons, inputs, labels.

shadows.name: ambient-small
shadows.purpose: Resting state for feature cards and primary buttons.

shadows.name: ambient-medium
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on feature cards, floating chips, showcase media.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Teal-tinted shadow under the accent CTA button.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Single authored scroll-reveal moment (translateY 18px to 0), respects prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-weight neutral CTA (ink fill); used alongside the accent CTA, e.g. hero secondary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; border-radius:999px; font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:15px; padding:14px 26px; border:none; background:#0b1220; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 2px 8px -2px rgba(11,18,32,0.08),0 1px 3px rgba(11,18,32,0.06); transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, background-color .18s ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#0b7f72; box-shadow:0 20px 40px -20px rgba(11,18,32,0.22),0 6px 16px -8px rgba(11,18,32,0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0e9f8e; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Primary high-intent CTA (teal fill with teal glow), e.g. nav/hero 'Оставить заявку'.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; border-radius:999px; font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:15px; padding:14px 26px; border:none; background:#0e9f8e; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 16px 32px -14px rgba(14,159,142,0.55); transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, background-color .18s ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background:#0b7f72; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0b1220; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Six-up capability grid card with a rounded-square pastel icon tile.
components.html:
Ученики и группы

Карточки студентов, курсы и подписки в одном месте.
components.css: .ds-feature-card { background:#ffffff; border-radius:22px; border:1px solid rgba(11,18,32,0.08); padding:30px 26px; box-shadow:0 2px 8px -2px rgba(11,18,32,0.08),0 1px 3px rgba(11,18,32,0.06); transition:transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-feature-card:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 20px 40px -20px rgba(11,18,32,0.22),0 6px 16px -8px rgba(11,18,32,0.1); } .ds-feature-icon { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:50px; height:50px; border-radius:15px; margin-bottom:20px; background:#e3f6f3; color:#0b7f72; } .ds-feature-icon svg { width:24px; height:24px; } .ds-feature-card h3 { font-family:'Unbounded',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:18px; margin:0 0 9px; color:#0b1220; } .ds-feature-card p { font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.55; color:#475569; margin:0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Lead-form text input with uppercase micro-label.
components.css: .ds-field { margin-bottom:16px; font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field label { display:block; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; color:#94a3b8; margin-bottom:7px; } .ds-field input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; font-size:15px; color:#0b1220; background:#f6f8f9; border:1.5px solid rgba(11,18,32,0.08); border-radius:12px; padding:13px 15px; outline:none; transition:border-color .15s ease, background-color .15s ease; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color:#0e9f8e; background:#fff; }

narrative.overview: This world exists to sell one claim: the dashboard on screen is the real, running product, not a mockup. Every material choice reinforces that — real screenshots in browser-chrome frames, pastel icon tiles that read as a product's own iconography rather than stock-art, a dark near-black footer that frames the page the way a device frame would. It was built to sit between two named competitors (eduschool.uz's cooler cyan-teal restraint, my-school.uz's brighter grass-green playfulness) and lands on a single confident teal-emerald (#0e9f8e), deliberately on a cool-neutral ground rather than either competitor's warmer paper tones — a B2B dashboard subject, not a bookish one. Confirmed visual rejections, both corrected at finish review: no kicker/eyebrow pill above any heading (five were shipped, then all five removed), and no decorative section numbering (the FAQ's 01–05 was cut for the same reason). This system is scoped to marketing/home.php only; two other visual systems already live in this codebase for different jobs (the per-tenant customer template, and the /admin + /admin/super operate surfaces) and are out of scope here.
keyCharacteristics: Single confident accent (teal-emerald) rather than a multi-brand rainbow
Cool-neutral ground, near-black ink, no warm/cream paper
Rounded-2xl white cards with soft diffuse (never hard-offset) shadow
Rounded-square pastel icon tiles, one hue per feature, drawn via Lucide SVGs
Pill-shaped buttons, badges, and chips throughout
Dark near-black-navy footer and two ink panels as the page's only dark surfaces
No kickers, no decorative numbering, Unbounded reserved strictly for display/headline use

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal-emerald is the only color used for interactive emphasis. The five pastel tile hues are decorative icon-background differentiators only and never carry interactive or brand meaning.

rules.name: The Unbounded-Never-Body Rule
rules.body: The display face appears only in h1-h4 selectors. No button, input, nav link, or paragraph is ever set in Unbounded.

rules.name: The Soft-Offset-Only Rule
rules.body: Every shadow in this world carries blur and a negative spread; zero-blur hard-offset shadows never appear — this is not a neobrutalist world.

dos: Do keep Unbounded confined to headline-level elements; Inter carries every other role.
Do source real admin-panel screenshots (with provenance preserved) for any future product-proof media on this page; never substitute a generated or stock mockup for "the real app."
Do rotate the five pastel tile hues for new feature cards rather than introducing a sixth hue or repeating one hue on adjacent cards.
Do use soft, blurred, offset shadows (ambient-small/medium/large) for all elevation; this is not a neobrutalist world.
Do keep this system scoped to marketing/home.php; new tenant-facing or /admin screens follow their own existing systems, not this one.
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above any heading on this page — confirmed removed at finish review (five instances cut), and the craft-floor ban applies regardless of future brief wording.
Don't add decorative section numbering (01/02/03-style) — the FAQ's was cut for the same reason; a sequence may only carry a number if the order itself is informationally necessary.
Don't introduce a second accent color competing with teal-emerald for interactive emphasis; the pastel tile hues are decorative-icon-only and must stay confined to that role.
Don't reach for a hard-offset, zero-blur shadow anywhere on this page.

Don't pull Quicksand/Font Awesome (the per-tenant template) or Space Grotesk (the admin/super operate surface) into this page's font or icon stack — three separate systems coexist in this codebase by design.
